title: Saucer Springs placement file (v1)
description: A venue as data: props from a kit GLB with a transform, colour variant and collision flag. Runtime checks the same essentials in web/wwwroot/rc/open-world/placements.js validatePlacements(). Format and authoring: docs/rc-placements.md.

note.description: Free text: where it is and why. Ignored at runtime.

kit.description: Kit GLB path relative to web/wwwroot/rc/assets, e.g. kit/props.glb. Must not contain '..'.

palette.description: sRGB multipliers indexed by item.variant; applied to a prop's Kit_Paint parts (every part if it has no paint). Index 0 should be #ffffff (authored colour). Default: placements.js DEFAULT_PALETTE.

prop.description: Top-level node name in the kit GLB, e.g. bench.

pos.description: World metres [x, y, z], three.js frame (+Y up). y null = snap the ground contact to the ground (world raycast, else elevationAt, else 0).

yaw.description: Degrees about +Y, counter-clockwise seen from above. Yaw 0: the prop's front faces -Z.

scale.description: Uniform scale about the ground contact.

variant.description: Index into palette (validated against its length).

collide.description: Add the prop's COL_ proxy to the collision world.
